title: Deep Sea Plain
definition: Also known as abyssal plains, deep sea plains are vast, flat, or gently sloping regions of the deep ocean floor lying between depths of 3,000 and 6,000 meters.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding ocean floor morphology, pelagic sedimentation, and mineral resource distribution (e.g., polymetallic nodules). Relevant for Mains GS-1 (Geomorphology & Oceanography) and GS-3 (Deep Ocean Mission, Marine Resources).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Deep Sea Plain formation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, bathymetric features, and international legal frameworks (ISA).
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
